overview: The show revolves around Juana, an active teenager who, as her nickname suggests, sees the world from a height of 1.20 meters. At her new high school, she battles the societal taboos surrounding disability, bodily diversity, and youth sexuality. The series is known for being a powerful, authentic coming-of-age story that uses both traditional screen formats and virtual reality to dive into her fantasies and experiences.
title: Metro Veinte

overview: In 1875, the Swedish industrialist Alfred Nobel, inventor of dynamite, having amassed a vast fortune after overcoming a series of setbacks, was looking for a multilingual secretary. Thus, Bertha Kinsky, a penniless Austrian aristocrat earning her living as a governess, arrived at his Parisian townhouse. But their close bond, forged from intellectual complicity, was short-lived: Bertha returned to Vienna to marry Arthur von Suttner, the son of her former employers. Fleeing the scandal, the couple went into exile in Georgia, where the young woman witnessed the horrors of the Russo-Turkish War of 1877-1878. Becoming a journalist and writer, she achieved resounding success with the pacifist novel *Lay Down Your Arms!*, and then rose to the vice-presidency of the International Peace Bureau, founded in 1891. While Alfred worked on developing smokeless gunpowder-which led to him being monitored by the French secret police-Bertha tirelessly tried, letter after letter, to win him over to her cause. The last wishes of her friend, who died at the end of 1896, confirmed the high opinion she held of him: they stipulated the creation of annual prizes to honor those who had "brought the greatest benefit to humanity" in the fields of chemistry, physics, medicine, literature, and... peace.
title: Alfred Nobel – Kärlek och Dynamit

overview: Dance Mums with Jennifer Ellison follows Jennifer Ellison and her pro dance team who train at her dance academy Jelli in Liverpool, England. It is the UK version of the popular US reality series "Dance Moms".
title: Dance Mums with Jennifer Ellison

overview: María Eugenia, a Venezuelan raised in Paris with free will, returns to her native country, where fate will make her undergo many changes. However, she did not imagine that she would meet Doctor Gabriel Olmedo and fall madly in love with him.
title: Nadie me dirá como quererte

overview: Mixed martial artist Islam Makhachev spends several days in his native Dagestan, sharing his everyday life outside of major tournaments: night fishing, a farm visit, a game of padel, training, and a football match between Dagestan and Ossetia.
title: Родина чемпионов: Ислам Махачев
Rebirth of Reiko: A Mother's Revenge

overview: This story is about the rise and fall of actors and celebrities within the entertainment industry. Not only is the war between the celebrities, but those who fight neck and bone to build them into who they are. People often see the war with celebrities because they are the face, but little do they know about the agents. The agents are people who know every inch and centimeter of a celebrities life, they can build you or kill your career. Every agent desires to have that #1 dara in their agency, and almost every agent will sell their soul or client for profit.
title: The Battle of Stars

overview: Sakiko is a 40-year-old editor working at a publishing company. While she is competent at her job, she can be a little lazy and absent-minded in her personal life. The story unfolds when Sakiko and her husband get involved in an accident with another couple. This incident causes the happy lives of both couples, which they had taken for granted, to suddenly crumble. Moreover, the "third Friday secret" involving her husband comes to light.
title: Until the T-Shirt Dries

overview: Lola is an extroverted, impulsive, and rule-breaking police inspector who meets Ágata, a brilliant and meticulous documentary filmmaker with autism spectrum disorder. Ágata possesses an exceptional memory and a unique talent for analyzing criminal files, while Lola brings intuition, field experience, and empathy for victims. Despite their vast personality differences, they form a perfect team and become friends while solving all sorts of complex criminal cases.
title: Ágata y Lola

overview: With her daughter's life on the line, a doctor's search for a kidney donor exposes a secret affair and a DNA test that could shatter two families.
title: El otro padre

overview: A look back at some of the most shocking and surprising mystery cases to come out of Medieval times.
title: Medieval Murder Mysteries

overview: A known terrorist launches a surprise cyber-attack on the U.S in order to gain control over their hypersonic missiles. FBI director Karen Smith enlists the help of two ex-military black ops soldiers to hunt down the culprits.
title: Hypersonic

overview: A ruthless detective investigating a series of bizarre murders uncovers a mysterious entity known as "ALIUS," forcing him to question reality as he races toward a shocking truth.
title: ALIUS

overview: NBA Showtime on NBC is a flagship basketball studio broadcast that provides in-depth analysis, expert commentary, and comprehensive coverage of the latest storylines, trades, and highlights from across the league. The program features a rotating panel of hosts and analysts breaking down player performances and team dynamics.
title: NBA Showtime

overview: The sixth generation members of Nogizaka46 will be taking on the challenge of singing "Showa era pop songs" and "Heisei era hit songs" for the first time in the "Nogizaka Star Tanjo!" series, which the fourth and fifth generation members previously took on.
title: Nogizaka Star Tanjo! Six

overview: In Kuizhou, beauty is measured by curves, while slim women are looked down upon. After inheriting her grandmother's Yanzhi Pavilion, Fang Zhuozhuo discovers a magical rouge made from the rare Qionghua blossom that transforms her into the voluptuous beauty Qingcheng, the pavilion's celebrated mistress. To fulfill her grandmother's final wish by winning the prestigious Beauty Selection Ceremony, she must secure a steady supply of Qionghua, a flower that grows only in the private garden of the Governor's residence. Determined to obtain the blossoms, Zhuozhuo marries Chu Shengyi, the Governor's third son. When her deception is exposed on their wedding day, she is reduced to the status of a concubine. Each enters the marriage with hidden motives: Zhuozhuo seeks the precious flowers, while Shengyi hopes to use Qingcheng's identity to rescue his true love, Ye Xin, from the manipulative Lady Li. After the Qionghua garden is destroyed in a fire, the two journey together to the black market in search of new seeds. As they cultivate the flowers side by side, an unexpected bond blossoms between them. Shengyi eventually discovers that Zhuozhuo and Qingcheng are one and the same. Joining forces, they rescue Ye Xin and uncover Lady Li's long-buried crimes, including the murder of Shengyi's birth mother, exposing her before all. With the outdated obsession for voluptuous beauty finally abandoned, Zhuozhuo takes rightful charge of Yanzhi Pavilion under her own name, while Shengyi promises to wait for her return.
title: She Who Blazes

overview: The Murder Detectives is a dramatic new documentary series, which will be stripped across three nights, following every twist and turn of a police investigation into the horrific murder of a teenager.
title: The Murder Detectives

overview: Set during the Northern Song Dynasty, the story follows Meng Qian, a young man from the capital city of Bianjing, who is forced into the power struggles of the imperial court and the martial world while trying to save his sister-in-law and younger sister. Caught between the Imperial City Bureau, the Liangshan heroes, Fang La's rebellion, and the hidden forces manipulating them all, Meng fights to survive. As he grows from merely protecting himself to embracing a greater sense of duty, he becomes determined to safeguard the future of the Song Dynasty. The series is a stirring tale of an ordinary man's coming-of-age, woven with themes of patriotism, family, and national destiny.
title: Lantern Festivalin Bianjing

overview: Isabel Archer, a vivacious New World ingénue who leaves America for Old World Europe, is keen to experience all that life has to offer. A young woman with charm and an innate intellectual curiosity, Isabel rejects a series of marriage proposals, but when she inherits an unexpected fortune that promises to grant her freedom, she falls prey to two American ex-pat schemers: the elegant Madame Merle and the charming but calculating Gilbert Osmond.
title: The Portrait of a Lady

overview: Gypsy TikTok star Trewley Precious is the youngest daughter in her large family. Can she challenge traditional gender roles, build a lucrative social media career, and get away with it?
title: Secret Lives of Gypsy Wives

overview: Aku Tak Membenci Hujan tells the story of Launa, a beautiful and cheerful girl who falls in love with Karang, who turns out to have a split personality. However, the unfortunate man wants to kill the Karang inside him. Karang prefers to be Banu, a small child, or Agha, a rebellious and disobedient teenager. Launa tries to get Karang back to his true self. But the man's heart is too broken to be the traumatized Karang, born of a mistake, hated for no reason, and considered worthless by his mother, leaving Karang Samudra Daneswara to live in sorrow. Will Launa find the love of Karang, who has never wanted anything in her life except a hug from Andira, her biological mother?
title: Aku Tak Membenci Hujan

overview: Inside The Langham: Britain's First Grand Hotel has exclusive access to the staff and guests at the luxury London hotel as it prepares for its 160th anniversary. With five kitchens under the watchful eye of Culinary Director and chef Michel Roux Jr., serving Michelin-starred cuisine, wedding celebrations and dinner events for hundreds of guests, the series reveals how The Langham competes with other high-end London hotels to attract visitors to its restaurants and rooms.
title: Inside The Langham: Britain's First Grand Hotel

overview: Charismatic, sarcastic, with a flask in his pocket and demons in his head, Kit is an experienced cop who knows the streets better than any GPS. His partner is a principled and slightly naive rookie who hasn't yet become disillusioned with the system. Together, they are like a two-person rock band, forced to play on the same wavelength. Each episode is a new investigation, a new challenge, and a new way to grow their audience. But behind the likes, hype, and banners lies a genuine pain and an attempt to cope with the past.
title: Коп-звезда

overview: As part of the project, TV presenter Alexei Stolyarov experiences every stage of preparation for a space flight: parachute jumps, training in a pressure chamber, an isolation chamber, and a centrifuge with 3G overload, dives in a hydrolaboratory simulating a spacewalk, and many other tests that cosmonauts undergo before being sent to the ISS. Throughout the project, Stolyarov, who endured colossal physical and psychological stress, was accompanied by instructors from the Cosmonaut Training Center, while Roscosmos employees facilitated filming and shared expert commentary.
title: Космическая экспедиция с Алексеем Столяровым

overview: A covert crime drama set in Philadelphia, following an off-the-books undercover task force known as the D.O.P.E. Unit as it wages a secret war against powerful crime families. As violence escalates and political pressure mounts, the series explores systemic corruption, moral ambiguity, and the consequences of institutional choices in a world where loyalty and justice collide. As the operation deepens, personal lives unravel, trust erodes, and every decision carries a cost that reshapes the mission and those sworn to uphold it.
title: D.O.P.E. Unit
Da Tang Shao Nian Tian Xing Zhuan

overview: Filmed at picturesque locations around the UK, contestants paint some of the UK's most spectacular scenery for a chance to win a £10,000 commission for the National Trust's permanent collection. Through several rounds, winners are selected to advance to the semifinal, and then to the final.
title: Landscape Artist of the Year

overview: A gripping documentary series uncovering how organized crime infiltrated Hollywood across the 20th century. As stars and gangsters overlapped, the line between glamour and crime blurred through unions, financing and the hidden power brokers. From early mob influence to later scandals and crackdowns, the series reveals how deeply the underworld shaped the film industry.
title: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies

overview: A Greek paradise turns tragic. A dangerous killer could be living next door. Romance and religion are tied to the death of two elderly neighbors. A serial killer is discovered hidden in plain sight. The Royal family is linked to a deadly scandal. A high-speed car chase turns deadly. The new docuseries 20/20 Britain's Most Notorious Crime Investigations reopens six of the UK's most high-profile crime cases, bringing the prestige and journalistic power of ABC News' legendary "20/20" brand to an international audience with premium, character-driven true crime.
title: 20/20 Britain's Most Notorious Crime Investigations

overview: BattleBots Pro League powered by Bright Data is the toughest robot combat event on the planet. 24 elite bots from across the globe converge on Las Vegas for the ultimate fight to the death. There are 6 Groups of 4 bots, each of which has to fight everyone in the Group. The Group winners progress to the Knockout rounds, so every fight matters and there are no second chances.
title: BattleBots Pro League

overview: In this darkly comic series, three gay friends in their late 50s are forced to face the fact that their lives have fallen far short of what they imagined for themselves when they were in their 20s. Dreams of wealth, career success, and lasting love have faded, replaced by a growing sense of the clock ticking and an urgent need to turn their disappointing lives around - before they are literally out of time.
title: The Disappointments

overview: Some sacrificed love for the sake of family. Others walked away from their families to protect the ones they loved. And some, believing they were acting out of love, only left deeper wounds behind. Years of misunderstanding and conflict have driven them apart, but an unexpected bond and reunion bring them face-to-face once again. As lost love, tangled family ties, and the true feelings they have long kept hidden begin to surface, even the coldest hearts slowly begin to heal. Through love, forgiveness, and the courage to understand one another, they discover what it truly means to be a family. Can the scattered pieces of a family finally find their way back to one warm table?
title: Love on the Menu

overview: The new Sunday Night Baseball package marks the return of Major League Baseball to NBC for the first time in more than two decades. The debut marks the beginning of a new three-year partnership between NBCUniversal and Major League Baseball and it comes on the heels of the debut season of Sunday Night Basketball, the first of an 11-year agreement between NBCU and the NBA.
title: NBC Sunday Night Baseball

overview: Park Kyung Hee appears to have it all: a thriving interior design business, an adoring social media following, and the perfect family image. To elevate her success, she orchestrates a friendship with her wealthy neighbor, Soo Jung, hoping to leverage Soo Jung's connections into an investment into her business. However, her carefully curated life unravels when she investigates rumors of her husband Lim Jae Hong's infidelity, only to discover him disposing of a dead body – and their daughter is allegedly responsible for the killing. Despite attempting to cover up the incident, they receive an anonymous message that someone has recorded them, forcing Kyung Hee to navigate a treacherous web of blackmail and deceit as they try to put their lives back in order.
title: The Affair Was Just the Beginning

overview: This unique new music series invites a host of artists to perform some of their favourite songs in an intimate setting. With no presenter, the focus is solely on the music as the guests play songs and reflect on their influences and inspirations.
title: Sky Arts Sessions

overview: Harry Jowsey is done playing the field. Now, his inner circle is stepping in to help steer his love life, weighing in on every date, every match, and every tough call as he navigates a handpicked pool of potential partners. Is Harry finally ready to find a wife and settle down for good?
title: Let's Marry Harry

overview: Introducing a new visual approach to true crime storytelling, Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos presents next generation visualizations of documented first-person accounts from Wuornos, those close to her, and the investigators who worked the case, accounts previously available only in verified transcripts, documented evidence, and chronicled firsthand testimony. The series brings a new dimension to the story of Wuornos and the investigation that brought her to justice - through the perspectives of those who lived it.
title: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos

overview: Ding Ning, a criminal defense lawyer whose biological dad is a kidnapper and whose stepfather is a criminal police officer, crosses paths with Yu Songfan, a chief judge grieving the loss of his wife and child, and Zhao Yijie, a darkly charming legal elite who walks the gray zone. Thrown together by gritty criminal cases, these three lonely people go head-to-head while quietly recognizing something of themselves in one another. Opponents, yet nearly kin. Each is both hunter and hunted. Who is the oriole pulling strings behind the curtain, and who is the cicada biding its time until summer?
title: Cicada

overview: In a world where giant robots are built and used for labor, a special police force of robots is created to handle crimes relating to these machines.
title: The Next Generation: Patlabor

overview: The story unfolds in a neighbourhood of Athens, in a house where two single sisters, Anna and Mitsi, live. The relationship between the two sisters is problematic, since their characters are completely different. But everything will change when Anna falls in love with the director of the company she works for, who is married...
title: Μικρές Αμαρτίες
BLACK TRICK: The Lawyer Who Controls Justice

overview: The reason for continuing to pursue her from the shadows is deeply intertwined with a horrific incident that occurred 25 years ago and the secrets each of them harbors . From the day he breaks his long silence and makes contact with her , his daily life begins to unfold in a thrilling way. People want to know everything about the person they love. But how far is that permissible? What if this love was all a setup...?
title: 25 Years of You

overview: A unique comedy series which began on Showtime cable channel, and then was moved to FOX where the next two seasons continued. The series revolved around Garry Shandling and his friends, who all are a part of his imaginary TV series which takes place in his home. Garry's platonic friend, Nancy, lives in the same building complex, as well as his friend Pete Schumaker and his family, wife Jackie and son Grant. Garry's mom also makes occasional appearances and refers to him as Bubba. The final season saw Garry marry Phoebe, who has to get used to being in front of the cameras.
title: It's Garry Shandling's Show

overview: A crime series set in Brabant. Jamie, an anthropologist from Utrecht, has her life together until she finds herself caught up in the Brabant underworld. Together with the shrewd Petra, she discovers a new side of Brabant and of herself.
title: Bovensloters

overview: The myth of the witch Baba Yaga is reinvigorated when a private investigator comes to a small coastal town to investigate the disappearance of a young heir to a powerful fishery and finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, a sexy university professor with a taste for younger men, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives and ancient magic.
title: Yaga

overview: That's what Friends Sex and Games is all about: four couples. And a sexy game that could change everything. At the center of this relationship dramedy are Anna and Paul, who've been together forever—just like their closest friends Julie, Valentin, Bella, and Leo. Their lives are running smoothly until Samu returns home with his girlfriend Siena and suggests a daring game to his old crew: the "Key Game." The rules are simple—the men toss their keys into a bowl, and the women each pick one out. Whoever draws a key spends the night with the key's owner. No strings attached, no obligations. What begins as a thrilling adventure quickly turns into an emotional powder keg. Old longings resurface, new truths come to light: Nothing stays the same. A series full of intense emotions, funny moments—and steamy sex.
title: Friends Sex and Games

overview: Set in the modern Scottish Highlands, Laird is an epic family saga in which a proud Scot defies a shadowy American billionaire hellbent on buying up the glens. Amidst family feuds, buried secrets and star-crossed romances, the Laird of Castle Drummoch remains determined to protect his ancestral lands from oligarchical land grabbing.
title: Laird

overview: Protective Custody follows a disgraced financier accused of massive fraud who is thrown into protective custody, where he must navigate prison politics, salvage his reputation, and confront the consequences of his actions while awaiting trial.
title: Protective Custody

overview: In Peculiar Stars, after a cyclone strands a young woman on a deserted island with a member of her fiancé's family, survival upends everything she thought she knew about love. But when they're finally rescued and re-enter their world of privilege, expectation and secrets, homecoming proves far more dangerous than the island they left behind.
title: Peculiar Stars

overview: In the series couples who appear to be opposites are expertly paired by Perel and a team of matchmakers and therapists, before embarking on an adventure in one of the world's most romantic and remote destinations. With more single people than ever before, and increasing levels of polarization and social isolation, this innovative experiment asks the question: could the last person on Earth you think you'd ever want to date end up being the one person you can't live without? And will an unexpected pairing in paradise open their horizons and be the beginning of a life-changing relationship?
title: The Last Person on Earth

overview: Hyun Jong Hyun works part-time at the Naeil Bookstore, but his dream of being a successful webtoon writer has been hampered by his emotionally-wounded, self-centered personality. On one rainy day, he meets a kindred spirit, a stray cat he brings home and names Bok Gil. From then on, Bok Gil becomes his only confidant. Though she can't offer advice, Bok Gil is a faithful source of comfort and support as he goes through difficult times. The story is told from both Hyun's and Bok Gil's differing points of view.
title: Imaginary Cat

overview: This documentary series explores how traditional recipes have shaped Korea's food scene, highlighting the popular pairing of fried chicken and beer.
title: Korean Fried Chicken Rhapsody

overview: In the summer of 1985, a young boy is found mysteriously drowned in the waters off Särsö. During a forbidden excursion to the legendary island of Svärtan, Johannes and his friends make a discovery that changes them forever.
title: Svärtan

overview: New school, new start — until vicious online attacks and a classmate's twisted challenge spark a dangerous bond that pushes Tamara toward transformation.
title: Proyecto Final

overview: The homicide department, led by the uncompromising boss Emma, is on the trail of the most serious criminals. Stories inspired by real Ostrava cases.
title: Místo zločinu Ostrava

overview: Marina Kapov is a cleaner at a Zagreb police station and a single mother of three. Although she hides her exceptionally high IQ of 160, her talent becomes impossible to ignore after she accidentally solves a complex case that seasoned detectives failed to crack. Recognizing her abilities, the police hire her as a consultant, pairing her with inspector Tomislav Ramljak, a strict, rule‑bound investigator. Their contrasting personalities gradually turn into a strength as they work together to solve challenging crimes.
title: IQ 160

overview: A single pill can be deadly. Killer High: The Series follows the families, survivors, and frontline voices confronting America's fentanyl crisis and the fight to stop it.
title: Killer High: The Series

overview: A retired football player turned manager relies on the support of a young lawyer as he navigates sensitive issues of the sport, the ghost of his failure as a player, and a troubled relationship with his father. Amidst the chaos, betrayals and sordid disputes, he struggles to achieve the success he lacked as an athlete.
title: Jogada de Risco

overview: This charming family adventure is a story of smelly monsters, dangerous humans and what happens when the things that go bump in the night move in next door. We follow Fungus as he goes through his paces, menacing and frightening those on the surface (the 'Dry Cleaners') as Bogeymen are meant to do and have always done. Unlike other Bogeyman, Fungus has to navigate his world colliding with our above ground world. Over the course of the four episodes, Fungus and his son Mould journey through the maze of life on the surface, while also discovering the highs and lows of their father and son relationship.
title: Fungus the Bogeyman

overview: A struggling writer's fear of losing his longtime girlfriend drives him into a reckless affair that forces him to confront his insecurities and the consequences of his choices.
title: All Masamune Wants is Happiness

overview: Luna faces fresh challenges and personal conflicts after an accident forces her away from the skating rink. The story features new songs alongside re-imagined versions of beloved tracks from the original series.
title: Soy Luna: Volver a Rodar

overview: The story follows three women who leave their hometowns for the Tokyo they've always dreamed of, envisioning bright futures and success. Faced with the realities of love, work, and family that do not always go according to plan, they cry together, support one another, and burst into laughter over the smallest things as they search for a life that is true to themselves at the crossroads of turning 35.
title: Tokyo Middle 30

overview: This tasty series traces Jjajangmyeon's flavorful evolution from its Chinese origins to its status as one of South Korea's most beloved comfort foods.
title: Jjajangmyeon Rhapsody
My Cold Co-worker Obsessively Loves Me

overview: Every day, America faces threats most people never see. From foreign adversaries to insiders, it's a constant battle. This series takes you inside some of the worst spy cases in recent history.
title: Spy Nation

overview: Every day across America the men and women of Law Enforcement respond to countless calls to save lives and help their communities. Rescue Nation tells their stories, from their perspective.
title: Rescue Nation

overview: Ko Gyeol, a brilliant architect living a flawless life, returns to his hometown after ten years at his grandfather's summons and enters a fierce succession battle within Kangsu Group. As head of Strategic Planning at Kangsu Construction, he relies on cold logic and calculated decisions to seize control. Meanwhile, Cho Eun-ae, a startup developer dreaming of a humane AI-driven world, fights to reclaim her company, Lucky Joy, after it is seized by Kangsu Construction. Their clash over "Joy," the AI at the center of it all, sparks intense rivalry between Gyeol and Eun-ae, but an unexpected incident forces them into an unlikely partnership. Amid conflict and cooperation, they grow closer, navigating a journey to take ownership of their own lives.
title: Our Happy Days

overview: Branded as a "mistress' daughter," Na Ji Ni carries lifelong stigma. No Yeong Ju, wrecked by her husband's betrayal, lives with unhealed wounds. Forced under one roof by the man who ruined them both, the two confront buried pain, clashing families, and years of prejudice—fighting to turn bitterness into strength, and maybe into something like family.
title: Family Register

overview: Based on Martha Raddatz's bestseller, The Long Road Home chronicles the events of April 4th, 2004, when a platoon was ambushed in Sadr City, Baghdad, in an attack that came to be known as "Black Sunday".
title: The Long Road Home

overview: Five very different teenagers are sentenced to community service. Under the supervision of a clumsy supervisor, every assignment leads to chaos, conflict and romance, while an eccentric detective investigates what really happened.
title: Taakstraf
We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together
Anne Rice's Queen of the Damned

overview: Meng Tingyu, who has harbored a secret crush on her dream man for a decade, reunites with Lu Suizhou. After unexpectedly becoming neighbors and entering into a contract marriage, the two find their long-buried love blossoming into a real romance as they share their daily lives.
title: Mr. Lu, I Want To Fall Madly In Love With You

overview: Li Wen, a programmer, deliberately approaches Gu Ting to get close to her father, the fiercely protective Gu Yan. Playing on Gu Yan's devotion to his daughter, Li Wen persuades the seasoned ex-tough guy to go undercover with him inside a telecom fraud syndicate, using their cover as programmers to uncover the truth behind Li Wen's fiancée's mysterious death. Together, they gather evidence against the syndicate's kingpin, Yan Li, and hand it over to the police, ensuring the criminals face justice.
title: Being An Undercover Agent

overview: We celebrate one of the UK's greenest counties, showcasing the many jewels in its crown.
title: Sussex: Jewel of the South Coast

overview: From rice cakes to dishes! The Jiraks became part-time workers at the space rice cake restaurant thanks to Torongi's scheme. A full-fledged forced employment restaurant labor adventure!
title: Space Rice Cake

overview: It's make it or break it time for each of the Teutul men as they head off in separate directions after a bruising family breakup. Who will come out on top as OCC and Paul Jr Designs start cranking out competing bikes, side by side, each week on American Chopper?
title: American Chopper
